The high scores across the three paths indicate a consistent relationship between Idarubicin and the target condition, likely due to the shared pathophysiological mechanisms involving the use of Decitabine in the treatment of these leukemia subtypes. The evidence supports a mechanistic link where Idarubicin may influence the disease process in patients with these genetic mutations, though the exact mechanism remains to be fully elucidated.
